notes:
Passed on the fake backend by python3 -m mhs.driver check (evidence contract_checked, never an MHS-Device level). DEVIATION FROM THE CARD: a direct Driver with native.py, not the PythonObjectDriver helper, because the upstream assembles every command as a binary Runze frame (address, command byte, two parameter bytes, checksum) and the helper cannot express that framing. The catalogue classes named in the card's hints do not bind this device: cap.fluid.aspirate.v1 and cap.fluid.dispense.v1 bind lab.liquid_handler/lab.pipette and need labware wells; cap.actuation.pump.v1 needs a flow rate in uL/s, while the clone exposes speed percent and step counts but no steps-per-second or gearing; cap.actuation.valve.v1 binds actuation.valve/fluid.valve and is a percent write; cap.motion.* binds robots or motion axes. The package therefore uses x-cap ids for move, aspirate, dispense, valve port, reset and speed. There is no cap.device.configure write: the only writable setting, speed, is stored locally by the upstream and is None until a set, so the package cannot expose a hardware state read that is valid before the first set; speed is an invoke instead. Hardware was never run and the hardware path was never imported: this package is model-authored and unreviewed, and the R2 hardware backend is refused by the loader until reviewed_by is set. native.py requires the serial port and the fitted syringe volume (a deployment setting); the fake is an in-memory object with placeholder values, not a recording, and does not describe any pump. The valve achieved position is NOT COVERED because the upstream has no getter for it; the select action reports the requested port only. No line of the clone documents an independent hardware e-stop, so the e-stop is the native ForceStop and the safe-state action x-cap.allenneuraldynamics.runze_stop.v1; force_stop waits for the device reply and then for a position query, and after connecting the upstream timeout is 60 s, so the hardware stop latency is not characterized. site-limits.example.json is an example operator overlay, not a statement about any pump. gate.digest is the digest the check printed; check-report.json is regenerated by every gate run and is not part of the package.
